prompt:
Add `MemberRegistry.import_csv(text)` in `shelf/members.py`.

`text` is CSV (use the `csv` module). The first row is a header naming at least `name` and `email` columns, in any order, and optionally `kind`. Blank rows are skipped; whitespace around cells is stripped. Each row registers a member through `register` (kind `standard` when there is no `kind` column or the cell is empty). A row whose email matches an existing member's email case-insensitively, including rows imported earlier in the same call, is skipped.

A header without `name` or `email` raises `ValueError`. An empty name or an unknown kind raises `ValueError` whose message contains `line N`, N being the 1-based line number in `text` (the header is line 1), and in that case the call leaves the registry exactly as it was. Returns the newly registered members in row order.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
